function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: load_skill
function.description: Load a Claude/Codex style SKILL.md by name when the user's task matches an Available Skills entry. This injects the full skill instructions and base directory before acting.

skill.description: Skill name exactly as listed in Available Skills

args.description: Optional arguments or task-specific target passed into $ARGUMENTS

search_roots.description: Optional debug/test override for skill root directories; normally omit

function.name: spawn_agent
function.description: Spawn a background subagent with full GA tool access for a well-scoped task. Use it only when the user explicitly asks for subagents, delegation, or parallel work, or an active GA SOP explicitly requires a verification/explorer subagent. Depth, research, or complexity alone is not authorization. Before spawning, identify the critical path: do urgent blocking work locally, and delegate only sidecar work that can run in parallel. Delegated subtasks must be concrete, bounded, and self-contained, materially advance the main task, and not overlap with local work or other subagents. Do not redo delegated subagent tasks yourself; integrate their results. Call wait_agent sparingly, only when you need a subagent update for the next critical-path step. The message should be a clear task contract: objective, scope/non-goals, relevant paths/context, allowed tools/constraints, expected final answer contract, artifacts if any, and completion/failure criteria. For coding/artifact work, assign disjoint write paths and require changed/generated paths in the final answer. By default forks all current context; set fork_turns='none' or a positive integer string to limit context.

task_name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only

message.description: Self-contained task prompt. Include the exact result needed next, constraints, relevant paths/context, and final answer contract; avoid vague requests and do not duplicate parent work.

agent_type.description: Optional role definition name loaded from .ga/subagents/<agent_type>.json or .md; role defaults can supply task_name, permission_profile, allowed/denied tools, and fork_turns.

fork_turns.description: 'all' (default), 'none', or a positive integer string for recent turns

permission_profile.description: Subagent permission profile: inherit-current-permissions, read_only, restricted_mcp, or explicit_approval

allowed_tools.description: Optional static tool allowlist for the subagent

denied_tools.description: Optional static tool denylist for the subagent

allowed_mcp_servers.description: Optional MCP server allowlist for restricted_mcp

background.description: Run as a background subagent process; false is recorded for future foreground/background handoff support but still uses the durable process runner in this version

isolation.description: Optional isolation mode. Use 'worktree' to launch the subagent from an isolated git worktree while keeping the parent task root for coordination files

ipc_mode.description: IPC mode. 'file' is the durable default. 'socket'/'pipe'/'event_server' request a resident realtime channel that pushes already-persisted events; it only becomes effective when GA_SUBAGENT_REALTIME_IPC=1 opens the channel, otherwise the durable file event bus stays the transport and ipc_fallback_reason explains why

llm_no.description: Optional model index; defaults to current model

function.name: list_agents
function.description: List subagents and their current state. Use after spawning or before cleanup.

include_output.description: Include final output snippets when available

function.name: wait_agent
function.description: Wait for a subagent mailbox/status update. Call wait_agent sparingly; use it as an event wait only when the next critical-path step needs a subagent update. It does not read final output content.

target.description: Optional task name or /root/task_name; omit to wait for any live agent

targets.description: Optional non-empty list of task names; overrides target

since_event_seq.description: Optional event cursor; return only subagent event-bus events after this sequence

function.name: read_agent_result
function.description: Read the authoritative final result of a completed subagent. Call after wait_agent reports completed status or when explicitly collecting results; prefer final result fields over raw output traces.

artifact_id.description: Optional artifact id such as final_output_round_0; reads that artifact from the subagent run manifest

include_transcript_replay.description: Include a read-only replay summary reconstructed from the sidechain transcript JSONL when parent_session_id and run_id are available

include_transcript_timeline.description: Include an editable replay timeline projection. Each item has event_key, resume_role, resume_content, and editable metadata for selective replay edits

include_resume_context.description: Include a backend-history-shaped resume context projected from the sidechain transcript; this is a recovery aid and does not restart the subagent

resume_context_edits.description: Optional edits keyed by transcript_timeline event_key. Each edit may set {resume_content: string} or {drop: true}; applied only when include_resume_context is true

max_output_chars.description: Maximum final output characters to return

function.name: resume_agent
function.description: Resume a closed or waiting subagent from its sidechain transcript, reuse the same agent_path/run_id, write a new message, and start the next turn without overwriting prior output/artifacts.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a mailbox message to a subagent without triggering a new turn.

function.name: followup_task
function.description: Send a follow-up task to an existing subagent and trigger its next turn after it becomes idle.

function.name: foreground_agent
function.description: Request a subagent foreground handoff. This records foreground state and emits events for observation; it does not take over an interactive TUI in this version.

function.name: background_agent
function.description: Request a subagent background handoff. This records background state and emits events; it does not change process ownership in this version.

function.name: attach_agent
function.description: Attach to a running subagent's live output stream: switch it to foreground handoff state and read an incremental slice of its current-round output from since_offset. Use next_stream_offset for the following call; stream_eof becomes true once the round has finished.

since_offset.description: Character offset already consumed from the current-round output

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this slice; omit for the whole remainder

function.name: detach_agent
function.description: Detach from a subagent's live output stream: read the remaining incremental output and switch the subagent back to background handoff state, keeping the same run_id and transcript.

since_offset.description: Character offset already consumed from the current-round output

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this slice; omit for the whole remainder

function.name: interrupt_agent
function.description: Ask a subagent to interrupt its current turn while preserving its task directory for follow-up.

function.name: close_agent
function.description: Close a subagent, request shutdown/termination, preserve final artifacts, and return the previous status plus closed state. The root agent cannot be closed.

target.description: Task name or /root/task_name; /root is not allowed

grace_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after writing _stop before terminating

cascade.description: Also close every agent below the target, deepest first, before closing the target itself. Use this when the target spawned its own subagents: closing it alone leaves them running with nobody reading their output. Closed descendants are reported in closed_descendants

cleanup_worktree.description: When closing a worktree-isolated subagent, capture git status/diff summary and remove the worktree directory after preserving the summary

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: codex_lesson_update
function.description: Record one LLM-proposed reusable coding lesson after reading a redacted Codex session packet. LLM analysis is required: do not use this for simple rule matches, raw logs, secrets, private paths, or project-specific facts. The tool validates, deduplicates, and stores candidates; independent source_hash values become promotion evidence.

evidence.description: Short evidence signals from the redacted packet timeline, verification, failure recovery, or seed observations

source_hash.description: Packet/session hash prefix from the packet; used as independent promotion evidence

state_dir.description: Optional isolated distill state directory for tests or explicit runs; omit for the default memory/codex_distill state

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed
